title: Bond Portfolio Builder - ML Trading Dashboard
description: Winning team project - Developed an ML-backed dashboard to assist bond trading activities. Achieved 80% accuracy in credit rating prediction and Z Spread prediction error within 10 basis points on average.
skills: Machine Learning, Teamwork, Financial Analysis, Predictive Analytics

body.raw:
## Overview

TEMG 4940C Bond Portfolio Builder (Jul 2023 - Aug 2023)  
Associated with The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

**Winning Team** | **Team Leader & MVP**

Developed an ML-backed dashboard to assist bond trading and portfolio management activities, delivering impressive predictive accuracy on critical financial metrics.

## Key Achievements

- **80% Accuracy**: Credit Rating prediction model
- **Precise Z Spread Prediction**: Average error within 10 basis points
- **Winning Solution**: Recognized as winning team
- **MVP Recognition**: Named Most Valuable Player for contributions

## Technical Implementation

### Credit Rating Prediction
Machine learning model trained to predict bond credit ratings with 80% accuracy, enabling traders to quickly assess bond quality and risk.

### Z Spread Prediction
Developed Z Spread (Zero-Volatility Spread) prediction model with exceptional precision, averaging error within just 10 basis points - critical for bond valuation and trading decisions.

### Dashboard Features
- Real-time bond analysis
- Predictive metrics visualization
- Risk assessment tools
- Portfolio management interfaces

## Technology Stack

- Machine Learning (TensorFlow/PyTorch)
- Financial Analysis
- Predictive Analytics
- Data Visualization
- Dashboard Development

## Impact

Enabled bond traders at JPMorgan to make more informed trading decisions with ML-driven insights, improving portfolio performance and risk management.
